receipts.locator: Data leakage 與 How to avoid data leakage
receipts.excerpt: Data leakage occurs when information that would not be available at prediction time is used when building the model.
receipts.inspection_note: Data leakage 與 How to avoid data leakage：先切分資料，訓練和測試保持分離，測試資料不參與 fit 或模型選擇；這些是測試獨立性的規則，不能單憑切分保證自然語言泛化。
